title: Bad Move
textBlocks:
Joshua is Tricked
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story
You will see that Joshua made a BIG MISTAKE
By not checking with God 
before he made a decision
WE MUST ALWAYS ASK JESUS TO HELP US MAKE RIGHT CHOICES

The Kings came together to fight Joshua
But the scared Gibeonites decided to trick Joshua
They LIED and said that they came from far (which was NOT true)
To prove their FAKE story 
They showed Joshua their old clothes 
Their worn out patched shoes from the long journey
How old and mouldy their bread was
How old their sacks were, full of cracks
Then they asked Joshua to be their friends and not fight them
Joshua didn’t ask God
And he went ahead and made peace with them
BAD MOVE JOSHUA
BIG MISTAKE not to ask GOD first
3 days later - Joshua found out the truth!
The Gibeonites had lied
They lived close by and Joshua wasn’t supposed to be friends with them
But now he had to keep his promise
So he didn’t fight them, but made them work for them
Carrying water and cutting wood!

COLOUR IN 
THE OLD CLOTHES AND MOULDY BREAD

Dear Jesus
Thank you that I can talk to You
Thank you that you love and care for me
Amen
